2607.29209.title: SAF-OPD: Stable Advantage Fusion for On-Policy Distillation
2607.29209.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) broadcasts a single response-level reward to every token, while on-policy distillation (OPD) scores each token against a stronger teacher for a dense advantage but caps performance at teacher quality and discourages exploration beyond it. Their complementarity makes combining RLVR and OPD promising, but we find that fusing the two advantages with a fixed coefficient triggers entropy collapse from two miscalibrations: a magnitude mismatch, where token-level OPD advantages can spike far beyond the bounded RLVR advantage and erase its signal, and a temporal mismatch, where sustained full-strength OPD keeps pulling the student toward the teacher and limits exploration needed to surpass it. We propose SAF, a Stable Advantage Fusion framework that resolves both issues via a lightweight, four-stage pipeline applied only to the OPD advantage: a sparsify-then-compress mechanism for magnitude control paired with a warm-up-then-anneal mechanism for temporal control, with each stage independently switchable and adding negligible overhead. Instantiating RLVR with GRPO, we evaluate SAF across seven mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks with Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B: SAF avoids entropy collapse and consistently outperforms fixed-coefficient GRPO+OPD fusion, improving the aggregate score by 0.51-2.70% across all six model-domain settings while achieving more stable training.
2607.29209.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習與可驗證獎勵 (RLVR) 對每個標記廣播單一的回應級獎勵，而在政策蒸餾 (OPD) 中，則是將每個標記與更強的教師進行評分，以獲得密集的優勢，但將性能限制在教師的質量上，並且不鼓勵超越它的探索。它們的互補性使得結合 RLVR 和 OPD 變得有前景，但我們發現用固定係數融合這兩種優勢會因兩種錯誤校準而觸發熵崩潰：一種是幅度不匹配，標記級 OPD 優勢可能會遠遠超過有界的 RLVR 優勢並抹去其信號；另一種是時間不匹配，持續的全強度 OPD 不斷將學生拉向教師，限制了超越所需的探索。我們提出了 SAF，一個穩定優勢融合框架，通過一個輕量級的四階段流程解決這兩個問題，該流程僅應用於 OPD 優勢：一個稀疏然後壓縮的機制用於幅度控制，配合一個預熱然後退火的機制用於時間控制，每個階段均可獨立切換且增加的開銷微乎其微。通過使用 GRPO 實現 RLVR，我們在七個數學推理和代碼生成基準上評估 SAF，使用 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B：SAF 避免了熵崩潰，並且在所有六個模型領域設置中，穩定地超越了固定係數的 GRPO+OPD 融合，將總分提高了 0.51-2.70%，同時實現了更穩定的訓練。
